questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup: Calculate the extra widening required (in meters, upto 2 decimal places) on a single lane road having a radius of horizontal curve of 70 m. The design speed is 30 km/h and the length of the wheelbase of the vehicle is 6m.
questions.questionText: Calculate the extra widening required (in meters, upto 2 decimal places) on a single lane road having a radius of horizontal curve of 70 m. The design speed is 30 km/h and the length of the wheelbase of the vehicle is 6m.
questions.explanationHtml:
0 (0 - 0)
As mentioned in IRC 73 : 2023, Table 6.6, no extra widening is to be provided for radius
greater than 60 m for single lane roads. For two lane roads, it is 300 m.
